headline: Om Power Transmission AGM results
summary: Om Power Transmission Limited passed all three ordinary resolutions at its 15th AGM held on September 30, 2026. Voting was conducted via remote e-voting and video conferencing.

headline: Virya Resources appoints new CS and Compliance Officer
summary: Virya Resources Limited appointed Krish Amish Shah as Company Secretary cum Compliance Officer effective September 30, 2026. Shah brings 30 years of experience in secretarial compliance.

headline: SIS buys back 1.3 lakh shares at ₹421.48 avg
summary: SIS Limited bought back 1,30,000 equity shares on September 30, 2026, at an average price of ₹421.48. Total shares bought back now stand at 21,74,134.

headline: Sical Logistics AGM passes all resolutions
summary: Sical Logistics Limited concluded its 71st AGM on September 30, 2026. Shareholders approved financial statements, director re-appointment, auditor appointment, and remuneration adjustments with overwhelming majority.

headline: CitiPort Financial Services AGM concludes with all resolutions passed
summary: CitiPort Financial Services held its 34th AGM on September 30, 2026. All three resolutions, including director re-appointments and financial adoption, were passed unanimously.

headline: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) reports superannuation of Pravir Dahiya
summary: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited announced the superannuation of Senior Management Personnel Pravir Dahiya, effective September 30, 2026.

headline: Viram Suvarn appoints SS Lunkad as secretarial auditor
summary: Viram Suvarn Limited appointed M/s SS Lunkad and Associates as secretarial auditor for five years starting FY27, following AGM approval.

headline: B&B Triplewall Containers holds 15th AGM
summary: B&B Triplewall Containers held its 15th AGM on September 30, 2026. Key resolutions included adopting FY26 financials and declaring dividends on equity and preference shares.

headline: Gajanan Securities adopts FY26 financials at 32nd AGM
summary: Gajanan Securities Services Limited adopted standalone and consolidated financial statements for FY26. Directors reappointed and loan approvals granted.

headline: Ridhi Synthetics AGM voting results declared
summary: Ridhi Synthetics Limited concluded its 45th AGM with all three ordinary resolutions passed unanimously. Promoters held 74% of votes polled, while public participation remained minimal.

headline: Infronics AGM adjourned due to tech failure
summary: Infronics Systems adjourned its 26th AGM on September 30, 2026, after technical issues prevented quorum. The meeting is rescheduled for October 7, 2026.

headline: Aarti Drugs leadership shift: Patil retires, Adhish becomes MD
summary: Prakash M. Patil retired as Chairman/MD/CEO on Sep 30, 2026. Adhish P. Patil was promoted to MD and relinquished CFO role effective Oct 1.

headline: Wherrelz IT Solutions holds FY26 AGM
summary: Wherrelz IT Solutions conducted its Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026, via video conferencing. Key resolutions included adopting FY26 financial statements and re-appointing director Sumanlata Dhareshwar.

headline: Vishvprabha Ventures holds 42nd AGM, approves debt conversion
summary: Vishvprabha Ventures held its 42nd AGM on September 30, 2026. Shareholders approved the conversion of unsecured loans into equity and reappointed Paresh Desai as executive director.

headline: Force Motors sales jump 57% in Sept 2026
summary: Force Motors reported a 57.13% YoY rise in total sales to 4,101 units in September 2026, driven by strong domestic demand despite export declines.

headline: CSM Tech reshuffles leadership, hikes VP pay
summary: CSM Technologies appointed Mrutyunjaya Panda as Chief Strategy Officer and raised Ashwini Kumar's remuneration to ₹1.01 crore effective October 2026.

headline: Zinema Media AGM approves ₹2.5 crore equity issue
summary: Zinema Media & Entertainment Ltd held its 42nd AGM, approving a preferential allotment of 24.99 lakh shares at par and re-appointing Baskaran Sathya Prakash as MD.

headline: Associated Ceramics adopts FY26 accounts at AGM
summary: Associated Ceramics Limited held its 56th AGM on September 30, 2026, adopting FY26 standalone accounts and appointing Arun Agarwal and Umang Agarwal as directors.

headline: Adani Ports doubles Colombo terminal capacity
summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd inaugurated Phase II expansion of Colombo West International Terminal, doubling capacity to 3.2 million TEUs with a USD 750 million investment.

headline: Horizon Reclaim holds first AGM post-IPO
summary: Horizon Reclaim (India) Limited conducted its 20th AGM, its first as a listed entity. The meeting approved financials for FY26 and reappointed directors.

headline: Kilburn AGM approves shift of registered office to Maharashtra
summary: Kilburn Office Automation held its 45th AGM via VC, approving the relocation of its registered office from West Bengal to Maharashtra and re-appointing a director.

headline: Hexaware defends RSU plans against proxy advisor objections
summary: Hexaware Technologies clarifies voting recommendations by IiAS and ISS on postal ballot resolutions. Company argues dilution is minimal at 0.33% and plans are net-worth neutral.

headline: ACS Technologies holds 33rd AGM via VC
summary: ACS Technologies Limited concluded its 33rd Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026, via Video Conferencing. The meeting covered FY26 performance and technology strategy.

headline: U. H. Zaveri appoints P H Shah as auditor
summary: U. H. Zaveri Limited has appointed M/s P H Shah and Co. as its statutory auditor for five years, effective FY27 through FY31.

headline: Indo SMC revenue doubles to ₹309.74 crore in FY26
summary: Indo SMC Ltd reported a 123% jump in revenue from operations to ₹309.74 crore for FY26. Profit after tax rose to ₹32.38 crore as the company held its 5th AGM.

headline: Annvrridhhi Ventures holds 46th AGM via VC
summary: Annvrridhhi Ventures Limited conducted its 46th Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026, via video conferencing. Key resolutions included director appointments and related party transactions.

headline: Mahindra Lifespaces adds ₹1,500 crore GDV in MMR
summary: Mahindra Lifespaces Developers Ltd. has added three redevelopment societies in Mumbai, boosting its gross development value by ₹1,500 crore across Borivali and Chembur.

headline: Padam Cotton Yarns concludes 32nd AGM
summary: Padam Cotton Yarns Limited held its 32nd AGM on September 30, 2026. Key resolutions included appointing Dharmesh Patel as Independent Director and increasing authorized share capital.

headline: Yes Bank gets ₹363 crore tax refund order
summary: Yes Bank received a consolidated refund order of ~₹363 crore for AY 2017-18 from the JAO, following appellate authority rulings. The amount exceeds the materiality threshold.

headline: 3C IT Solutions turns profitable in FY26
summary: 3C IT Solutions & Telecoms reported a profit after tax of ₹57.52 lakh in FY26, reversing a loss from the previous year. Revenue rose to ₹58.47 crore.

headline: OMDC gets 2-month AGM extension
summary: Orissa Minerals Development Company Ltd received a two-month extension from the ROC to hold its 108th AGM for FY26, citing delays in CAG comments.

headline: HUDCO H1FY26 loan disbursements rise 37% to ₹35,371 crore
summary: HUDCO reported loan disbursements of ₹35,371 crore for H1FY26, a 37% increase from ₹25,838 crore in the same period last year. Loan sanctions stood at ₹1,04,592 crore.

headline: RO Jewels holds 8th AGM via video conferencing
summary: RO Jewels Limited concluded its 8th Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026, via video conferencing. The meeting addressed financial statement adoption and auditor appointments.

symbol: Sahara One Media And Entertainment Limited
stock_name: Sahara One Media And Entertainment Limited
headline: Sahara One holds 45th AGM, adopts FY26 financials
summary: Sahara One Media and Entertainment Limited held its 45th AGM via VC on September 30, 2026. Members adopted audited standalone and consolidated financial statements for FY26.

headline: Apoorva Leasing holds 43rd AGM, reappoints MD
summary: Apoorva Leasing Finance & Investment Co Ltd held its 43rd AGM on September 30, 2026. Key resolutions included the re-appointment of Atul Singh Tyagi as Managing Director and M/s P M S R & Co. as statutory auditors.

headline: Unicommerce AGM approves AI object, ESOP changes
summary: Unicommerce eSolutions held its 15th AGM on September 30, 2026. Shareholders approved amendments to the Memorandum of Association to include Artificial Intelligence objects and revisions to the Employee Stock Option Scheme 2019.

headline: Stellar Capital Services concludes 32nd AGM
summary: Stellar Capital Services Limited held its 32nd Annual General Meeting for FY26 on September 30, 2026, via video conferencing. Key resolutions included director reappointments and secretarial auditor appointment.

headline: BSE fines Hampton Sky Realty for delayed results
summary: BSE levied ₹2.53 lakh fine on Hampton Sky Realty for Q1FY27 result delay. Promoter accounts face freeze risk amid ED probe disruptions.

headline: Shamrock Industrial reports FY26 loss of ₹108.66 lakh
summary: Shamrock Industrial Company Limited reported a loss of ₹108.66 lakh for FY26, up from ₹12.60 lakh in the previous year. The company remains non-operational with nil revenue.

headline: Panorama Studios concludes 46th AGM via VC
summary: Panorama Studios International held its 46th AGM on September 30, 2026. Key resolutions included revising related-party transaction limits to ₹1,500 crore and borrowing powers.

headline: Stratmont Industries concludes 42nd AGM with key appointments
summary: Stratmont Industries held its 42nd AGM on September 30, 2026, adopting FY26 financials and approving new independent directors and borrowing limits.

headline: GNG promoter sells 34 lakh shares worth ₹230 crore
summary: GNG Electronics promoter Vidhi S Khandelwal sold 34,20,345 equity shares on NSE for ₹230.80 crore, reducing stake to 8.80%.

headline: Tandhan Energies appoints MR & Associates as secretarial auditor
summary: Tandhan Energies Limited, formerly Shah Foods, appointed M/s. MR & Associates as secretarial auditor for five years starting FY27.

headline: Veerkrupa Jewellers appoints new secretarial auditor
summary: Veerkrupa Jewellers Ltd appointed M/s Madhav Upadhyay and Associates as Secretarial Auditor for FY27-FY31, effective April 1, 2026.

headline: Desco Infratech AGM adjourned due to lack of quorum
summary: Desco Infratech Limited's 15th Annual General Meeting was adjourned on September 30, 2026, due to insufficient quorum. The meeting is reconvened for October 7, 2026.

headline: Ola Electric passes all AGM resolutions
summary: Ola Electric Mobility passed all resolutions at its 9th AGM, including re-appointments of independent directors and approval to raise funds through securities issuance.

headline: Swastika Infra concludes 7th AGM, adopts FY26 financials
summary: Swastika Infra Limited held its 7th Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026. Members adopted the audited financial statements for FY26 and approved the reappointment of Director Ruchira Gupta.

headline: Yes Bank receives ₹258 crore from trust
summary: Yes Bank Ltd received ₹258 crore from a trust in its Security Receipts Portfolio linked to the NPA sale to JC Flower ARC, exceeding materiality thresholds.

headline: Veerkrupa Jewellers appoints P H Shah as auditor
summary: Veerkrupa Jewellers Ltd appointed M/s P H Shah and Co. as statutory auditor for five years, FY27 to FY31, following AGM approval on September 29, 2026.

headline: Magnus Steel holds 48th AGM; approves office shift
summary: Magnus Steel & Infra Ltd held its 48th AGM via video conferencing on September 30, 2026. Shareholders approved the shifting of the registered office and reappointed directors.

headline: Senthil Infotek AGM: 8 resolutions passed
summary: Senthil Infotek Limited passed all eight resolutions at its 32nd AGM, including the appointment of a Joint Managing Director and two Independent Directors.

headline: Gujarat Natural Resources posts profit, expands drilling
summary: Gujarat Natural Resources reported a return to consolidated profitability in FY26 with a profit of ₹989.31 lakh. Standalone revenue surged to ₹1,147.66 lakh as three wells entered commercial production.

headline: Sammaan Capital appoints P.S. Negi as LIC nominee director
summary: Sammaan Capital appoints P.S. Negi as LIC nominee director effective Sep 30, 2026, replacing Rajiv Gupta.

headline: BRNL AGM concludes; auditors issue modified opinion
summary: Bharat Road Network held its 19th AGM on September 30, 2026. Members adopted FY26 financials despite a modified opinion from statutory auditors and a qualification in the secretarial audit report.

headline: ACME Solar commissions Phase-III BESS in Rajasthan
summary: ACME Solar Holdings commissioned 53.63 MW/214.52 MWh BESS phase in Rajasthan, bringing total capacity to 159.58 MW. COD set for October 2, 2026.

headline: Hero Motors holds 27th AGM, adopts FY26 financials
summary: Hero Motors Limited concluded its 27th Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026. Shareholders adopted the audited financial statements for FY26 and approved director re-appointments.

headline: Jonjua Overseas signs MoU with Catobo LLP
summary: Jonjua Overseas Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Catobo LLP to collaborate on helipad and vertiport design solutions, aiming to enhance aviation infrastructure in India's border and hill states.

headline: Sarup Industries AGM: Lotus Bawa expansion, new directors
summary: Sarup Industries held its 47th AGM. Key updates include Lotus Bawa brand expansion on e-commerce, a trading suspension due to a clerical error now resolved, and the appointment of two independent directors.

headline: Vantage Knowledge Academy holds 13th AGM via VC
summary: Vantage Knowledge Academy Limited conducted its 13th Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026, via video conferencing. Key agenda items included adopting FY26 financials and regularizing three independent directors.

headline: Priya Ltd concludes 39th AGM with director re-appointment
summary: Priya Ltd held its 39th AGM on September 30, 2026. Members adopted FY26 financials and re-appointed Aditya Bhuwania as Whole-Time Director via e-voting.

headline: Carborundum Universal infuses $3 million into Cyprus subsidiary
summary: Carborundum Universal infused $3 million into CUMI International Limited to support the closure of its German subsidiary, CUMI Awuko Abrasives GmbH.

headline: Eros Media passes all resolutions at 32nd AGM
summary: Eros International Media Limited held its 32nd AGM on September 30, 2026. All four resolutions, including director re-appointments and financial adoption, were passed.

headline: DP Wires holds 28th AGM, adopts FY26 financials
summary: DP Wires Limited held its 28th Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026. Shareholders adopted the audited financial statements for FY26 and approved the re-appointment of Mr. Arvind Kataria as a director.

headline: PTC Industries AGM approves FY26 financials
summary: PTC Industries held its 63rd AGM on September 30, 2026. Members approved audited financial statements for FY26 and reappointed Smita Agarwal as director.

headline: Indrayani Biotech sells 1.83% stake in subsidiary
summary: Indrayani Biotech Ltd completed the sale of a 1.83% stake in its subsidiary Dindigul Farm Product Limited on open market basis on September 30, 2026.

headline: Bombay Super Hybrid Seeds re-appoints Richa Mashru
summary: Bombay Super Hybrid Seeds Ltd re-appointed Richa Kaushal Mashru as Independent Director for a second 5-year term starting October 1, 2026.

headline: Highway Infrastructure wins ₹220.66 crore toll contract
summary: Highway Infrastructure signs a ₹220.66 crore contract with UPEIDA for toll operations on the Gorakhpur Link Expressway for a duration of 2 years.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Cupid, NLC India, Interarch in focus
summary: Cupid surges 8.2% on raised FY27 guidance and Baazar Style stake conversion. NLC India rallies 2.3% after winning a 265 MW BESS bid and approving a JV with Nalco.
